purpose: Teach: キャサリン/永田町/シェリー/ビクター/ディーン/クラッチ/ハンス/マルタ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英王室キャサリン妃の特集観てたな
lines.en: Riku — you were watching that Catherine, Princess of Wales documentary.
lines.style: Playful accusation with a sharp edge. Quick, caught-you cadence. Slight smirk in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で永田町習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about Nagatacho in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a question-back. Calm but slightly flustered. Cool-distant mask slipping just enough.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、シェリー酒の名前覚えてたな
lines.en: Riku — you actually remembered the name of that sherry brand.
lines.style: Surprised accusation. Softer than the first one, almost impressed. Raised eyebrow in the tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ビクターのレコード見てたな、桜
lines.en: You were looking at those Victor record sleeves again, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Turn-it-back challenge. Steady, knowing. Not mean — just matching her move.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ジェームス・ディーン主演の映画観てたな
lines.en: Riku — you were actually watching a James Dean film.
lines.style: Observational, slightly mocking. Dragged-out 'actually' with a wry lilt. Playing the know-it-all role.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、車のクラッチ操作練習してたな、桜
lines.en: You were practicing your clutch work in the car again, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Calm counter-observation. Patient but pointed. Noticing the small things she thinks he doesn't see.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ハンス・クリスチャン・アンデルセンの童話読んでたな
lines.en: Riku — you were reading Hans Christian Andersen stories.
lines.style: Softer surprise. Lingering on the gentleness of it. Less teasing, more curious what he was actually feeling.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でマルタ騎士団習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about the Knights of Malta in social studies, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Closing mirror. Quiet, close, knowing. Almost intimate in its observation — he's been paying attention the whole time.
